name: AP Biology
frameworkVersion: AP Biology Course and Exam Description, effective Fall 2025 (current PDF on AP Central, checked 2026-11-08), with College Board's Clarifications and Corrections implemented as of June 2026.

frq.setsNote: Whole released exams (PDF, College Board), linked from the course's past-exam-questions page and checked to load on 2026-11-08. They are not matched to units. Scoring guidelines are on the course's past-exam-questions page. The 2023–2025 sets were written for the CED in effect before Fall 2025.

source.title: AP Biology – AP Students (College Board)
source.note: Unit names, the “topics may include” lists, and exam weightings were read from this page on 2026-11-08 and are recorded exactly as written there, including two apparent typos on the page: “Structure of water hydrogen bonding” (the CED says “Structure of Water and Hydrogen Bonding”) and “Natural and aritificial selection”. Some weightings on the page use a hyphen instead of a dash; StudySprint writes them with a dash.

frameworkCheck.title: AP Biology Course and Exam Description (effective Fall 2025)
frameworkCheck.how: The 60 numbered CED topics (1.1–8.7) were read from the current PDF on AP Central and cross-checked against College Board's Course at a Glance; each is matched to the StudySprint topic whose guide section and questions teach it. The Clarifications and Corrections (implemented as of June 2025 and June 2026) change front matter, sample exam questions, resource locations, and Progress Check wording only; no unit or topic changed.
frameworkCheck.weightsSource: the AP Students course page (“On The Exam”), checked 2026-11-08; the CED's Course at a Glance gives the same ranges
differences: The AP Students page's topic list is a summary of the CED's topics in different words (for example, it lists “Mutations” under Unit 6 and “Population genetics” under Unit 7, matching CED topics 6.7 and 7.4, but does not name 7.5 Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium separately). Both lists are recorded and both are build-checked.

generalResources.title: OpenStax Biology for AP® Courses (whole book)
generalResources.note: General: a free biology textbook written for AP courses. Its chapters follow a textbook order, so they don't line up one-to-one with the current AP units.
generalResources.licenseOrRights: Linked only. OpenStax lists Biology for AP® Courses under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Its text was not copied or adapted here.
